note: The poller has read the empty book (CASH and FNO lists): its silent baseline.
Groww refuses the CASH list: the poll fails (order_api.py:139-145, orders.rs raw_orders), publishes nothing and keeps its baseline.
The FNO list is refused too; the CASH read still fails first, so this poll is an error as well.
CASH answers again with an open order; FNO is still refused, which the poll skips (order_api.py:146), so the book is the CASH list.
The open order is new against the baseline kept from before the failures, so it is relayed: a failed read neither publishes nor resets the baseline.
